name: Suminoe Takako
source:
A former graduate of St. Michael's who is now a teacher at the school's primary division. Takako is very embarrassed that [url=/c3034]Runa[/url] can easily dominate her while stealing her first kiss. 
[spoiler]She was once in love with Runa's older sister, [url=/c10132]Rena[/url].[/spoiler]

[Edit from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sono_Hanabira_ni_Kuchizuke_wo]Wikipedia[/url]]
